body_plan: liquid drop (one piece - head IS the body)
material: water in a surface-tension skin; body colour #53BEF5 family (settei day model)
volume_rule: STRICTLY preserved - wider if and only if shorter (wx * hy = 1)
rest_shape: upright droplet, canon cutout proportions (w/h ~ 1.11 in cutout space)

idle.description: continuous wobble-breathing: width +6% / height -5% anti-phase, painted highlight rides the form; every 3rd-4th loop a secondary action (small hop or side bulge) breaks the loop (BW anti-monotony rule)
idle.secondary_break: side bulge or mini-hop every 3-4 loops

breathing_equivalent: the wobble IS the breathing (surface pulse)

locomotion.cycle: squash 3f -> stretch toward travel 2-3f -> land squash 3f -> wobble-settle 10-14f diminishing
locomotion.ground_contact: bottom point; squash anchors to ground, stretch anchors to centre while airborne

settle: damped oscillation, overshoot +4% past rest, >= 2 visible cycles, 10-16f

secondary_chains.behaviour: rides the warp with the form (painted in)
bulge -> neck -> detach -> fall with stretch; body recoils up slightly; after big squashes and when sad/nervous
ring/bulge travels across the form ~6-10f after impacts

signature_motions.name: victory double-bounce
signature_motions.note: two hops, drip flicked off on the second

emotion_map.sad: sag -15% height, slow/no recovery, drip rate up

state_map.hurt: idle speed down (BW rule: weakened = slower animation)
state_map.sleep: puddle-lean, wobble nearly still, slow drip

forbidden_motions: rigid translation at constant shape (statue on a conveyor)
shape-identical frames > 12f while awake on screen
smear_drawing: elongated drop, 1-2f only, on fastest travel beats
sound_linked_motions: cry = whole-body pulse (the cry comes from the body, not the mouth alone)

spring.note: low stiffness, low damping = long wobble (per-frame units at 24fps)
